title: Vietnamese-Style Carne Guisada Tacos
description: A fusion of traditional Mexican tacos filled with slow-cooked Vietnamese-inspired beef shank, served with crispy bun and a side of spicy nuong salsa.

ingredients.name: thit nuong sauce (peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice)

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high. Sear beef shank pieces until browned on all sides.
Add fish sauce, coriander powder, and 1 cup water. Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to oven at 300°F (150°C) for 2-3 hours, or until tender.
While beef cooks, toast bun pieces until crispy. Chop cilantro for garnish.
Assemble tacos by placing beef shank on toasted bun, topping with nuong sauce, sour cream, cucumber, and cilantro.
Serve with lime wedges on the side.
